rules.title: A measurement names what produced it
rules.text: This repository's docs are read as evidence, so every number carries its date and the model, endpoint or command that produced it — `measured 2026-09-19 on oMLX`, `verified with cargo test`. A number with no source cannot be re-checked, and reads like one that was invented.

judgement.question: Does this line state a result — a number, a verdict, a comparison — without naming the model, endpoint, date or command that produced it?

criteria.true: it asserts a result while naming no model, endpoint, date, command or harness anywhere on the line
criteria.false: the source is named on the line, or the line claims nothing (a heading, a rule of the contract, a quotation of someone else's words)
